description: React component for rendering and managing the post view in a chat application, including loading states and scroll position handling.

classes.name: PostView
classes.description: React component extending React.PureComponent to display and manage chat posts with scroll and loading controls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.name: changeUnreadChunkTimeStamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for unread posts and manages loading state.

methods.name: toggleShouldStartFromBottomWhenUnread
methods.description: Toggles the scroll position preference for unread posts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the post list or loading screen based on loading state.
